# Attica Air Duct Cleaners

> Professional air duct cleaning service serving Greater Orlando, Florida. Specializing in air duct cleaning, dryer vent cleaning, chimney inspection, attic insulation, air purification, condenser coil cleaning, solar attic fans, and attic removal. Licensed, insured, and 5-star rated.

## About

Attica Air Duct Cleaners is a licensed and insured air quality company based in Orlando, FL. We serve residential and commercial customers across Orange, Seminole, Lake, and Volusia counties. Our technicians use Negative Air Pressure Technology for thorough, deep cleaning of air duct systems.

Our journey began with a clear mission: to bring cleaner air and healthier living environments to the homes of Orlando and its surrounding areas. What started as a small local business has grown into a trusted provider of residential and commercial HVAC air duct cleaning services in the greater Orlando, Florida area. Every project includes a detailed before-and-after photo and video report.

## Services

- [Air Duct Cleaning](https://www.atticacleaners.com/air-duct-cleaning): Unlimited vents. Remove dust, allergens, pet dander, mold, and musty odors. Residential and commercial air duct cleaning.
- [Dryer Vent Cleaning](https://www.atticacleaners.com/dryer-vent-cleaning): Up to 7ft. Fire prevention, lint removal, improved drying efficiency.
- [Chimney Cleaning](https://www.atticacleaners.com/chimney-cleaning): Creosote removal, carbon monoxide risk inspection, flue blockage clearing.
- [Attic Insulation](https://www.atticacleaners.com/attic-insulation): Professional blow-in insulation for energy efficiency and comfort.
- [Air Purification](https://www.atticacleaners.com/air-purification): Whole-home air purification systems installed into your HVAC.
- [Condenser Coil Cleaning](https://www.atticacleaners.com/condenser-coil-cleaning): Improve HVAC efficiency and reduce energy consumption.
- [Solar Attic Fan](https://www.atticacleaners.com/solar-attic-fan): Solar-powered ventilation to reduce attic heat and energy costs.
- [Attic Removal](https://www.atticacleaners.com/attic-removal): Safe removal of old insulation, debris, and contaminants.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How much does air duct cleaning cost in Orlando?
Attica Air Duct Cleaners offers a $97 special per A/C unit that includes unlimited vents, maintenance cleaning, coil condition check, air flow inspection, and duct condition inspection. No hidden fees.

### How often should I have my air ducts cleaned?
We recommend air duct cleaning every 3–5 years for most homes. If you have pets, allergies, asthma, or have recently completed renovations, annual cleaning is advisable.

### How long does air duct cleaning take?
A typical residential air duct cleaning takes 2–4 hours depending on the size of your home and number of vents.

### Do you serve areas outside of Orlando?
Yes. We serve all of Greater Orlando including Winter Park, Altamonte Springs, Sanford, Longwood, Oviedo, Windermere, Winter Garden, Clermont, Apopka, and more.

### Is dryer vent cleaning really necessary?
Yes. Clogged dryer vents are a leading cause of house fires. Safety experts recommend annual dryer vent cleaning to protect your home and keep your dryer running efficiently.

### Are your technicians certified and background-checked?
Yes. All Attica technicians are certified, background-checked, and trained in advanced Negative Air Pressure Technology.
